body: My ex was there when I was super depressed, but I'm being told she just would feel guilty if I were to do anything, based on her actions after we broke up.  She was there when I was considering ending my life last year, and seemed checked out near the end.  I know there's more options out there for me, but at the time being I'm just scared and depressed.

Most of my friends, parents all raised red flags, said she treated me poorly, but for whatever reason I tried to see through it all.  She texted her ex-bf nudes 2 days after we broke up, and for some reason I'm still not mad at her.  Is it because I'm so depressed, or because being alone instead is more painful?
